author: William Romero
description: ActiveDurable runs multi-step business flows (checkouts, onboarding, payouts) as durable sagas stored in your own database. Completed steps are checkpointed and never repeated after a crash, failures before the point of no return are compensated in reverse order, and failures after it are retried.…
